data.name: Duckified Cosmic Legends
data.detailed_description:
Duckified Cosmic Legends is a side-scrolling, rhythm-based, action, musical, platformer game set across a wide variety of universes, timelines, and eras.

Across 12 different and dynamic universes, players will battle, dance, race, and sing off against otherworldly demons, gigantic robotic megalomaniacs, an ancient deity turned businessman, a raging band of racing raccoons, a gross and all-consuming virus, and more.

Cosmic Legends combines a multitude of gameplay styles, primarily focusing on time-based platforming and accuracy-based combat.

Throughout its whopping 66 levels (split across 13 Worlds and 3 Acts), your goal is to score as many style points in as little time as possible. Collect Duckies, Secrets, and Wristband Pieces to advance your way through, and once you beat a level your performance will be graded on a scale: F D C B A S

Achieve S Rank in Time and Style, collect all your Duckies, and you'll officially earn your P RANK in a level.

P Rank every level in an Act, and you'll earn a secret level ;)

"To defeat these ancient gods, myths, and rulers: you'll truly have to become... a legend."

Somewhere in space, in a retro-futuristic world inhabited by a kingdom of ducks:

The royal Prince Joe Duck is enjoying his life of luxury, relaxation, and power. Until one day, when his evil twin brother, Jasper Duck, beckons him down underground, unveiling his newfound power.

After a heated battle, Joe is banished across the multiverse by his brother; forced to fight his way back, searching timelines for his power, meeting unlikely allies, facing his own fears, and working his way home to challenge his chaotic brother.

Duckified Cosmic Legends has a stacked cast and crew behind it! As the game grows in development, the cast will too!

STARRING:

  • Branden Floyd as JOE DUCK (Aiko's Adventure, WTC: Love's Labour's Lost)

  • Isaac Pabon as JASPER "THE DARK DUCK" DUCK

  • John Whinfield as KING JULIUS DUCK (The Gaslight District, The Amazing Digital Circus, Fallen Aces)

  • Robin van der Niet as QUEEN TABITHA DUCK (The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball, BloodMoney, This Magical Girl is a B*tch!)

  • Corey LeVier as JUNIOR (Spooky Month, X-Men: The Audio Drama, Mashed)

  • Robin Nelson as PRESIDENT HYPERION (Poppy Playtime, Suction Cup Man, Fazbear & Friends)

  • Katarina Contreras as AUDREY DUCK (Dead Estate, Juniper, Meta-Ghost: The Breaking Show)

  • Dontae Majors as ORION (A Hero Among Us, Cupid's Club, Dial Zoey!)

  • Ayla Lunes as KENZI (Knights of Guinevere, Disadventure Camp, Cycle of Struggle: Ardengrad)

  • Adam Argam as RUBEN (Nomori, PASTA VAN GISTER, Boardwalk Dad Detox)

  • Kaden Alexander (Echoes of Eternity, Occhi Lucidi, Our Himbo Turned into a Werewolf and This Dead-Beat Dad is Our Only Hope)

  • Betty Bat (Good Enough, Blackbolt, "He Was My Devotion, Now I’m His Regret")

  • Meggie-Elise (Genshin Impact, Spy X Family, The Worlds Divide)

  • Mateo Gonzalez

  • Tyler Sampsonis

  • Michael Mata

Each World of the game will also feature a guest composer, with Mathias Bard taking the helm as the lead composer of the game. You can check out more information regarding the cast and crew on the game's IMDb page.

data.short_description: Duckified Cosmic Legends is a fast-paced, musical game all about the multiverse, sibling rivalries, ancient legends, and with a whole lot of ducks! Fight your way across numerous realities through action-packed levels combining high energy parkour, skill-based combat, and electrifying rhythm.
